result.rationale: The diff adds `totalPages: Math.floor(this.get('user_count') / this.get('limit')) + 1` in admin-group.js.es6. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100/50), floor(2)+1 = 3 pages instead of 2, so `showingLast` (propertyEqual currentPage, totalPages) is false on the real last page; the `next` action then sets offset to min(offset+limit, user_count)=100 and calls group.findMembers(), fetching an empty phantom page. Correct formula would be Math.ceil. Verified mechanism, real correctness defect.
